# Inter

Inter 4.1 Regular, the settings panel's font, unmodified from the upstream release
[Inter-4.1.zip](https://github.com/rsms/inter/releases/download/v4.1/Inter-4.1.zip)
(SHA-256 `9883fdd4a49d4fb66bd8177ba6625ef9a64aa45899767dde3d36aa425756b11e`, file
`extras/ttf/Inter-Regular.ttf`). SIL Open Font License 1.1: `LICENSE.txt`.
`src/native/ui/font.cpp` embeds it with `#embed`; `SHA256SUMS` records the font.
